issue.title: `gh pr edit` fails with Projects classic deprecation when reviving a PR
issue.body:
## Command

`gh pr edit 1743 -R <private-repo> --body ...`

## Observed behavior

The operation exited 1 without updating the PR body:

```
GraphQL: Projects (classic) is being deprecated in favor of the new Projects experience, see: https://github.blog/changelog/2024-05-23-sunset-notice-projects-classic/. (repository.pullRequest.projectCards)
```

## Expected behavior

Editing the PR body should succeed independently of deprecated Projects (classic) fields. This matches the already-closed report #13069, but this command still fails in the current installed GitHub CLI.

## Environment

GitHub CLI version: `gh version` not yet collected in this session. The authenticated `gh` operation targeted a private repository PR; no content was changed.

comments.author: babakks
comments.body:
Thanks for reporting this, @brunobarrientos! :pray:

This looks similar to previously fixed issues involving the deprecated `projectCards` field, but we need a little more information to determine whether this is an older CLI version or a new regression.

Could you please provide the complete output of `gh version`, how GitHub CLI was installed, and a redacted `GH_DEBUG=api` trace of the failing command? Please remove any tokens or sensitive repository information from the trace.
